item.title: [New] Windows 11 shows where to tap a security key on display-based NFC readers; admins can switch the indicator through a new CredentialProviders policy
item.description:
Makes phishing-resistant security-key sign-in easier on tablets and convertibles, which removes one reason users fall back to passwords on shared or kiosk-style Windows devices.

Windows · If you roll out FIDO2 security keys on Windows 11 devices with display NFC readers, decide whether to enable the indicator with the CredentialProviders CSP or GPO and add it to your passwordless pilot. Confirm in your own tenant.

item.title: [New] Out-of-band hotpatch fix for Windows Server 2025: servers with Router Advertisement enabled can crash with stop error 0x139 after the November hotpatch (KB5138318)
item.description:
An unexpected stop on a hotpatched Windows Server 2025 host is an availability incident that can look like tampering in the SOC queue; the fix arrives only through Windows Update.

Windows Server · Confirm hotpatch-enrolled Windows Server 2025 hosts with IPv6 Router Advertisement enabled received KB5138318; check for unexpected 0x139 bugchecks since the November hotpatch. Confirm in your own tenant.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1567263 Microsoft 365 Copilot: New notification option when pinning Copilot to the Windows taskbar
item.description:
Microsoft 365 introduces an optional notification for admins pinning Microsoft Copilot to the Windows taskbar for selected groups. This notifies users with an Open Copilot action, enhancing communication and adoption. Rollout begins late November 2026. Admins must enable and schedule notifications via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1567262 Microsoft 365 Backup: Up to 10-year recovery windows for SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description:
Microsoft 365 Backup now allows configurable recovery windows up to 10 years for SharePoint and OneDrive, extending from the previous 2 years. Administrators can set recovery periods from 3 months to 10 years, while Exchange backup windows remain unchanged. No action is needed unless longer retention is desired.

Microsoft 365 suite, SharePoint Online, Microsoft OneDrive · stayInformed

item.description:

Windows · Pilot KB5132057 on test rings, and tell the SOC to expect one extra restart on devices receiving the Secure Boot certificate update.
